newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dollar ends flat after quiet session.
newsitem.headline: Canada dollar ends flat after quiet session.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended around C$1.3903 (US$0.7192) on Friday, softer from opening levels, but unchanged from Thursday's close * Traders said Canada unit has positive bias, trading between C$1.3860 and C$1.3910 heading into Monday's session * Little market reaction to 0.8 pct rise in Canada composite leading indicator for July
Analysts said low U.S. inflation data released earlier have dampened expectations for a U.S. interest rate hike and a corresponding move by the Bank of Canada.
But interest rate concerns are expected to weigh on financial markets in the months ahead.

"The (U.S. Federal Reserve) may ultimately stay the course, but look for market worries over a fall rate hike to build in the next two months," CIBC Wood Gundy said in a report. "That may be the push the (Canadian dollar) needs to take aim at C$1.40, forcing the Bank of Canada into a defensive rate hike," the report said.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 84.36 Japanese yen from 83.03 yen on Thursday and fell to 1.3059 marks from Thursday's 1.3173 marks.
